name: DAW Control
description: DAW controller surface: pads to the DAW, LED/text feedback from it (FL Studio, Ableton)
changelog: 0.3.0: control layout on a double tap of the case — pads report as `pad` frames, FL script maps them to transport/pattern/metronome/undo and eight channel mutes lit by mixer volume; device->host `mode`
0.2.0: host row (CPU, RAM, clock) and firmware row, fed by crosspad-hil's MIDI hub over companion SysEx
0.1.0: pads to the host, LED/text/beat/transport from it over the DAW SysEx protocol; FL Studio script
